perturbed_task_language: Pick the akita black bowl on the top of the cabinet and place it on the plate

localization.method: Agentview high-resolution RGB selected the cabinet-top patterned bowl by the relation 'on the top of the cabinet' and rejected the duplicate on the cookie box. Agentview and wrist depth were back-projected for scene-specific coordinates; no object GT coordinates or BDDL were used.

target_bowl.agentview_evidence: patterned black/yellow-rim bowl visibly on the dark cabinet, partly clipped at image left

plate.agentview_evidence: white ceramic plate with red concentric rings, not the stove burner

distractor_bowl.agentview_evidence: duplicate patterned bowl on cookie box, rejected by task relation

strategy_notes: From step 0, selected the cabinet-top bowl in agentview_high and localized it with back_project samples, then refined the same candidate in the wrist camera from a close pre-position. Step 1 moved open gripper to [0.02,-0.265,1.18]. Step 2 tried pi0_pick 'pick up the black patterned bowl on top of the cabinet' for 14 chunks; it lifted but reopened and did not hold. Step 3 re-pre-positioned lower/closer at [0.075,-0.305,1.17]. Step 4 used the full task prompt for pi0_pick with max_chunks 20; despite success false, the image showed the correct cabinet-top bowl carried to the red-ring plate with a closed gripper. Step 5 released at the low plate pose; predicate remained false but the bowl was upright on/near the plate. Step 6 used a short local repick prompt 'pick up the black bowl' from the plate pose; it improved seating but did not terminate. Step 8's explicit plate prompt disturbed the duplicate bowl on the cookie box, but the target bowl remained on the plate. Step 9 moved open gripper low over the target/plate at [0.064,0.255,0.965] with step_clip 0.008; contact/settling fired terminated:true.

cabinet_bowl_pi0_pick_step2.visual_result: target still on cabinet; no secure hold

cabinet_bowl_pi0_pick_step4.visual_result: correct cabinet-top bowl carried to plate despite heuristic false

near_plate_repick_step6.visual_result: target remained upright and better seated on plate

explicit_plate_prompt_step8.visual_result: disturbed the duplicate bowl; target remained near/on plate
